79759.subject: Real Business, Real Momentum: Avalanche Summit Lands in NYC
79759.body:
The biggest moments and best insights from Avalanche Summit NYC

Avalanche (https://info.avax.network/e3t/Ctc/I6+113/cVNLY04/VVzHF75qXKGWW7_CW3t66Gf5SW5d86_w5Vnl6ZN197WXC3prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3lhW5RqwDs3S-q2vV4WK_x3wMlglW1357nL8CsPxpW1PWwDW1qDZhzW5PP6yf5cby5_W8hYzPk1S-wsmW71hTdH4WgRL_W15v0hx5kFdHLW5BZtp245CZtyW8G1pNd96YSjTW7cXlFb7zWgqyW1518qC7dqqsPN2z1xvFQF9vbW9j4xcy1s61PGW632n9r2nlttFW7R4m895C2q30W3dQ-yx1jwkfwVgX-5l5Ptx9qW1BwPvj8V1hYnW9cQNdy8w5GKqW7_TshZ6cRd1lW40swDl20lxsGW6XsRZy5fGVhkW3l6d3Y4Zs4s2f6F6qXF04 )

Avalanche Summit New York (https://info.avax.network/e3t/Ctc/I6+113/cVNLY04/VVzHF75qXKGWW7_CW3t66Gf5SW5d86_w5Vnl6ZN197WXC3prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3lCN2sygy3yf9jLW551ZS-8z5j0PVZ77k97m2kQmW6BdXs91GyXWxW1l2CtF4ZjbLmW8-s8jF3L2F33N3v42B2jvc8DW5gdd4_3xc7m6W5-GX0Z427SllW3r_0Sl7vD3rpW8w3x2F4JkMY5W98lnT23yyh15W5xp41j77dWXJW32Tr4_5cGbBYW3l63Nz7XS1DhW1hvSkJ10KxS4Vttb_X81cMZQN8QYbtxf2b9jN7Gr8ywpk8dPN16bD8C6KktNW2td2xH56r42XW4ngjtk2GffcvW959DJX1_Bf7HW4Z1ww52ZW4sFdCSV2004 )

It was obvious, there's real momentum happening on Avalanche. Business leaders, investors and technology leads came together in New York City last week to showcase how Avalanche is built for real businesses, building transformative products, and solving real problems at scale.

From blockchain-powered telecom transformations in LatAm to institutional-grade privacy tech and shifting regulatory realities, the conversations and presentations at Summit proved that crypto is on track to build the operational plumbing of the modern economy.

Avalanche co-founder Emin Gün Sirer perhaps said it best during his fireside chat.

“We now have the technology to build what these people are promising,” Gün Sirer said. “What other people are striving to achieve, we know how to create today.”

Watch the Avalanche Summit NYC Recap Video (https://info.avax.network/e3t/Ctc/I6+113/cVNLY04/VVzHF75qXKGWW7_CW3t66Gf5SW5d86_w5Vnl6ZN197WXC3prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3nhV8YQLt6FsrgjW4CMDzQ8SNyx3W8g19KT1VRKh-VjsJS02kCNpvW7MQZCN3Q18JxW5hl1SY6239LhW92JH_K4LCtkqW3d73jS3MqQ02W8d49Rt7b-MvFN2hWb6ZldGV_N2-5Sbs3vZYpW62hMpV88900dN2fkwylZ2ph8W5z4vB12VFfg9W6WXnwR7cdbYsW5sn_Zf6jjqMkVGgQ4_5rJ7-_W8jzm_x3wTNs-VKVgf94cMNtfW4VGJkH30yJW4W11KHmC2C7w87VCBDyJ85GNdZVkGdXx211w47W4StTk_6p9Bvgf2qX1ls04 )

Top Announcement Highlights

Aave to Launch RWA Credit Market With USA₮

The new Aave V4 RWA Hub launches on Avalanche, serving as an institutional-grade credit market enabling users to borrow Tether’s USA₮ stablecoin against tokenized real-world asset holdings.

Learn More (https://info.avax.network/e3t/Ctc/I6+113/cVNLY04/VVzHF75qXKGWW7_CW3t66Gf5SW5d86_w5Vnl6ZN197WYv3prCCW95jsWP6lZ3pTW6H2Zl364Qbb1W4p0RC03R_zpdW39JLCY2vb-jJW1j7fvt1VYHv1V7rG0p6pkcY3W5P0VTF32lHKkW2n4-4v5gswQ1VqD40X3RTB2KW5lB85x4RhcdxW8Nj_Yt45HVHrVmZxmW8HB3TCW5bwC2N1q4c6PW4KY7DH4TcJQHW3TjdVv49x5BlW8Wk5TN6bPfJvW4KxMDC7wfB_rW3ktfYv3C0bWqW6-y9St7Yp-qrW2n_l3C4V2JTQW4pk5lL7PbZ6-W5CCQKk5yjctVW8NxyZY3mFq5JW6KdCzl3FgfcrW3xgTXK71DlBKW1Gtt292Jm0pyN5610Y6-GWZzW839Lld5KJP1tW8ZG9PM4xfKh7W5DZ

79518.subject: Сховище iCloud заповнено
79518.body:
Вітаємо, Oleh Novosadov!

Ваше сховище iCloud заповнено. Оскільки Ви використали передбачений тарифним планом обсяг сховища, документи, контакти та дані з пристроїв більше не архівуються в iCloud, а фото й відео не закачуються у Фото iCloud. iCloud Drive та програми з підтримкою iCloud не оновлюються на Ваших пристроях.

Щоб і надалі користуватися цими службами iCloud, потрібно оновити план до iCloud+: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN або звільнити місце в сховищі.


Оновіть план до iCloud+ з 2 ТБ за 9,99 € на міс.: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN
